npcs.note: Softening by NUMBER of repairs (0 to 3), matched to the portrait cues. State 0 is the drawn rigid idle; state 1 holds the last frame of vale_react_reconsidering (shoulders drop 1 px). States 2 and 3 (arms relax, weight on one leg; open asymmetric stance) are not drawn yet, so the same pose stands in until the art lands (see NEEDS_ART.md). The epilogue pose is vale_interact_s (releasing the audit).
Arrives first (with Noor) after the first repair: silhouette at its arrive cell, sprite once it moves to its gather cell. Laughs on arrival (ivo_laugh).
Arrives with Ivo after the first repair; posture upright.
Arrives with Ada after the second repair; sits less, stands at ease.
Arrives with Hal after the second repair; lantern rim baked into the sprite.
Arrives last, after the third repair, as the final door opens; wears all patches earned so far.

notes: The atrium tree landmark is placed as its registered parts at one cell (kit rule), so each repaired branch swaps one part: nameplates (The Name), floor lines (The Route), pots plus the daylight pool plus the windows (The Count). The kit landmark atrium_tree lists the same parts for its before/after states.
The final door is not a gate: it opens inside level 20 after the third repair (flag executive-door-open) and is therefore a state change on the final_door placement.
Cells x 0-8, y 15-19 (south-west lounge) sit under the keyboard inset at x4 and hold decor only.
